newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to firmer.

text.p: U.S. spot millfeed prices were mostly steady to $1.00 a ton firmer as dealers noted a pickup in nearby demand.
"There is better spot demand in Missouri, Oklahoma and Texas," a St Louis dealer said. "It could be that CBOT corn is stabilising."
Kansas/Oklahoma spot prices were bid and offered at $98/$103.00, respectively, up $1.00.
Another dealer agreed demand was better. Products like corn gluten were more expensive with the advent of cold weather, prompting feed mixers to use more midds, he said.
But in the Carolinas, spot demand had not improved.
Spot values were unchanged with spot November offered at $97.00. There were no bids.
"We are not hearing that (demand is better) in the South," a Carolinas dealer said. "The hard part is that there are no bids."
